verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents AI-Drafted Retrospectives. When an incident is resolved, it generates a comprehensive draft with a structured overview, timelines, impacts and preliminary Lessons Learned. A per-question "Draft with AI" option analyzes the incident record inside configurable retrospective templates, which teams then review and edit collaboratively. Missing for 10: explicit mention of contributing factors and follow-up/action-item generation in the AI draft, and independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
